These v1 journal fixtures were generated by `journal_write` extracted from the
actual v1.7.5, v1.10.3 and v1.10.4 `deploy/linux/update.sh` tags, with panel/agent
and all four phases. Only `sync` was replaced by a no-op while extracting bytes
on Windows; Linux tests exercise persistence separately. They are not generated
by the new Go writer.

The `updater-*.sh.gz` files contain the corresponding complete, unmodified tagged
updaters (`git show vVERSION:deploy/linux/update.sh | gzip -n`). Shell tests run
them to create old interrupted snapshots and transfer recovery without the new
state helper. The v1.10.3/v1.10.4 readers also validate the new writer's output.
